# instrument_port

<!-- Generated by orb-weaver-kicad-board-docs from board.yaml and board-manifest.yaml; do not edit. -->

Subsystem sheet `/instrument_port` of **mouse-joystick-pcb**, from the board recipe `subsystems/instrument_port.subsystem.yaml`.

The InstrumentPort-Digital-50 DUT boundary on a sheet of its own: every instrument tap and firmware marker the board exposes, renamed at the boundary from the DUT block's DIG channel names to the board's _INST nets; no parts of its own.

Board note: board-authored sheet, 0 parts

## Notes

- The channel order and grouping follow docs/interface-map.md, InstrumentPort-Digital-50 Pinout; the DUT block's DIG channels are read-only buffers, so a tap loads its net with one CMOS input and nothing on the instrument side can drive the board.
- Shared bus lines (the TMC SPI, the DAC I2C) are tapped once, by the board, in the sheet that owns the pull; a block's own signals carry their _INST tap inside the block (layout convention 14).
